# arin_net (Data Source)

Read the full registration details of an existing IPv4 or IPv6 network by handle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_net" "example" {
  handle = "NET6-2602-F805-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Network handle.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (List of String) Ordered lines of comments.
- `customer_handle` (String) customer handle returned by ARIN.
- `ip_version` (Number) ip version returned by ARIN.
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `net_blocks` (Attributes List) net blocks returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--net_blocks))
- `org_handle` (String) org handle returned by ARIN.
- `origin_asns` (List of String) origin asns returned by ARIN.
- `parent_net_handle` (String) parent net handle returned by ARIN.
- `poc_links` (Attributes List) poc links returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))
- `registration_date` (String) registration date returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--net_blocks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `net_blocks`

Read-Only:

- `cidr_length` (Number) cidr length returned by ARIN.
- `description` (String) description returned by ARIN.
- `end_address` (String) end address returned by ARIN.
- `start_address` (String) start address returned by ARIN.
- `type` (String) type returned by ARIN.


<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Read-Only:

- `function` (String) function returned by ARIN.
